verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Read Replicas, kept in sync with the primary, that you can read from for "Improved latency," and it lets you choose the region where primary project data is stored. The evidence does not explicitly show replicas being deployed in multiple geographic regions near users worldwide, or which regions are available. Edge Functions running at the edge is compute, not data placement, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-region replica placement, list of available regions, routing of reads to the nearest replica, independent or hands-on latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can place data or replicas in regions close to my users to keep read latency low worldwide

citations.quote: Read Replicas are additional databases kept in sync with your Primary database. You can read your data from a Read Replica, which helps with: Load balancing... Improved latency... Redundancy
The region you choose also determines where your primary project data is stored.
